container.description: Logical container/grouping the gateway belongs to (same field as other resources).

host.description: Name of the compute resource (in the same scope) this gateway runs on. The gateway reuses the host's provisioning/firewall/SSH and inherits its provider; it declares no provider of its own.

pki.description: Name of the two-tier (mesh) PKI in pki.enc.yaml the gateway's client leaf (<scope>/gateway) mints from. Every route target service must declare the same pki (a callee only trusts callers chaining to its own mesh).

subdomain.description: Public subdomain daemons connect to. The fully-qualified domain is composed at realization from the scope and base domain.

routes.description: the external API surface: each entry path-routes daemon traffic to a backend service, resolved through the mesh. The target service must permit the gateway (list "gateway" in its mesh.allowed_services).

path.description:
URL path prefix (normalized to /

/); unique within the gateway.

service.description: name of a service (same scope) this path routes to via the mesh.
